scenicChapters.narrative: Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through. 40 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it.

places-hadrian-s-wall-and-associated-fea.story: A 342 km round trip from Bardon Mill - roughly 5 h 54 in the saddle. It goes by way of Hadrian's Wall and vallum between Banks Gr, Drumburgh Roman fort and Hadrian's Wall be, Low Mire and Ravenglass Roman fort bath-house. The line favours views over speed.
